summary.text: FLESJE AS (959 690 308), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1991-01-11; address Flesjane 2, 6899 BALESTRAND, Norge. Main industry is Rental and leasing of water transport equipment (77.340); 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Rune Andersen; Board chair: Rune Andersen. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 98.16 k, operating profit NOK -56.97 k, net profit NOK -35.88 k, equity NOK 1.32 m, total assets NOK 1.28 m.
